title: MAD II — Project
standfirst: A full front-end + back-end application built to a real specification, delivered as the MAD II capstone.
instructor: Prof. Nitin Chandrachoodan & Mr. Thejesh GN
syllabus_body_html:
This project is an advanced course that builds on the foundations of "Modern Application Development - I," focusing on creating dynamic web applications using Vue.js. It covers key concepts such as token-based authentication, asynchronous task execution with Celery and Redis, caching techniques, and essential security practices including CORS, enabling students to develop scalable and secure applications. This Project provides hands-on experience in building end-to-end web applications using technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Flask, APIs, and SQLite. It focuses on developing secure, efficient, and deployable applications while applying core web development concepts.

Co-requisite: BSCS2003: Modern Application Development I

Faculty:

  • Prof. Nitin Chandrachoodan, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras
  • Mr. Thejesh GN, Independent Technologist, Multiple Affiliations

How the project runs:

  • The objective of this project is to provide hands-on experience in developing a web application using Vue.js and related technologies.
  • Students build a functional web application featuring interactive front-end components, state management with Vuex, token-based authentication, and asynchronous task execution using Celery and Redis.
  • The project reinforces concepts from "Modern Application Development - I" and introduces advanced web development techniques.
  • The viva consists of two levels, with the final round conducted by industry experts and contributing significantly to the final grade.
